$comment: Safety & policy guardrails. The agent may not act outside this. Loaded by src/config.ts; overridable per-run with --policy <file>.

allowlist.$comment: Only these origins + path prefixes are navigable. Anything else is blocked before the action runs.

risk.$comment: How an action's risk class is decided during discovery/replay. Intent from the LLM or step can override, but never downgrade an irreversible match.

handling.$comment: What to do per risk class. In discovery, risky/irreversible steps are recorded but flagged; unattended replay obeys these.

redaction.$comment: Values matching these patterns are masked in ALL logs, evidence, DOM snapshots, and artifacts. Params flagged redact: true are stored only as references, never as raw values.
